limitations: IRS universe is matched individual income-tax returns, not all residents/households. n2 is individuals represented on returns, AGI is thousandUSD, not earnings per migrant.

CSV pairs include same-state different-county movers but exclude nonmovers, foreign/special totals and aggregate residual destinations. Therefore sums understate published total flows; do not use them as closed full-population routing weights.
Disclosure thresholds suppress small flows; no zeros imputed. Causal migration motives cannot be identified from tax addresses.
